title: The Selfish Giant: English short story with meanings
description: Read The Selfish Giant by Oscar Wilde in English: the full text with simple meanings for hard words. Level A2–B1, about 11 minutes.
intro: A giant builds a wall to keep children out of his garden, and winter never leaves it. Oscar Wilde's fairy tale uses short sentences and a lot of repetition, so it is a gentle first story at A2–B1. A few old words such as hath and thee are explained.
